mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sa_wrong_question (user_id, question_id, topic, wrong_count, mastered) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, #{topic}, 1, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE topic = VALUES(topic), wrong_count = wrong_count + 1, mastered = 0, last_wrong_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE sa_wrong_question SET mastered = #{mastered} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sa_wrong_question WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
